    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">二、OpenCloudOS Server 9 系统 安装 Nginx</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="opencloudos-server-9-安装-nginx-完整指南">OpenCloudOS Server 9 安装 Nginx 完整指南</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>安装目录：<code>/usr/local/nginx</code>，配置 systemd 自动启动，通过 IP 访问 index.html</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="安装流程概览">安装流程概览</h2>
<pre><code>安装依赖 → 下载源码 → 编译安装 → 创建 systemd 服务 → 配置防火墙 → 验证访问
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="第一步安装编译依赖">第一步：安装编译依赖</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dnf install -y gcc gcc-c++ make pcre pcre-devel zlib zlib-devel openssl openssl-devel wget
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="第二步下载-nginx-源码">第二步：下载 Nginx 源码</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd /usr/local/src
wget http://nginx.org/download/nginx-1.26.2.tar.gz
tar -zxvf nginx-1.26.2.tar.gz
cd nginx-1.26.2
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>如需最新稳定版，可到 <a href="http://nginx.org/download" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">nginx.org/download</a> 查看版本号并替换上方链接。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="第三步编译并安装到-usrlocalnginx">第三步：编译并安装到 /usr/local/nginx</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">./configure \
  --prefix=/usr/local/nginx \
  --with-http_ssl_module \
  --with-http_v2_module \
  --with-http_gzip_static_module

make -j$(nproc)
make install
</code></pre>
<p>安装完成后目录结构：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>路径</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx</code></td>
<td>可执行文件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/conf/nginx.conf</code></td>
<td>主配置文件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/html/</code></td>
<td>网站根目录</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/logs/</code></td>
<td>日志目录</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 id="第四步创建-systemd-服务单元自动启动">第四步：创建 systemd 服务单元（自动启动）</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cat &gt; /etc/systemd/system/nginx.service &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Nginx HTTP Server
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
PIDFile=/usr/local/nginx/logs/nginx.pid
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx -t
ExecStart=/usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx
ExecReload=/bin/kill -s HUP $MAINPID
ExecStop=/bin/kill -s QUIT $MAINPID
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
</code></pre>
<p><strong>加载并启用自动启动：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 重载 systemd 配置
systemctl daemon-reload

# 启动 Nginx
systemctl start nginx

# 设置开机自动启动
systemctl enable nginx

# 查看运行状态
systemctl status nginx
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="第五步配置防火墙放行-80-端口">第五步：配置防火墙放行 80 端口</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 放行 HTTP 80 端口
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=http

# 如果同时需要 HTTPS 443
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=https

# 重载防火墙规则
firewall-cmd --reload

# 确认规则生效
firewall-cmd --list-all
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="第六步验证-indexhtml-页面">第六步：验证 index.html 页面</h2>
<p>Nginx 默认已在 <code>/usr/local/nginx/html/index.html</code> 生成欢迎页面，可直接通过 IP 访问，或自定义内容：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 查看默认 index.html
cat /usr/local/nginx/html/index.html

# 自定义首页（可选）
cat &gt; /usr/local/nginx/html/index.html &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
&lt;!DOCTYPE html&gt;
&lt;html&gt;
&lt;head&gt;&lt;meta charset="UTF-8"&gt;&lt;title&gt;My Server&lt;/title&gt;&lt;/head&gt;
&lt;body&gt;
  &lt;h1&gt;Nginx 运行正常&lt;/h1&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;OpenCloudOS 9 + Nginx /usr/local/nginx&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/body&gt;
&lt;/html&gt;
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>浏览器访问：</p>
<pre><code>http://你的服务器IP
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="常用管理命令汇总">常用管理命令汇总</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>操作</th>
<th>命令</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>启动</td>
<td><code>systemctl start nginx</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>停止</td>
<td><code>systemctl stop nginx</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>重启</td>
<td><code>systemctl restart nginx</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>重载配置</td>
<td><code>systemctl reload nginx</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>查看状态</td>
<td><code>systemctl status nginx</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>测试配置语法</td>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx -t</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>查看版本</td>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx -v</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 id="关键路径一览">关键路径一览</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>路径</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/sbin/nginx</code></td>
<td>可执行文件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/conf/nginx.conf</code></td>
<td>主配置文件</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td>网站根目录</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>/usr/local/nginx/logs/</code></td>
<td>日志目录</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td>服务单元文件</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
